```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#| context: setup
library(sysgenAnalysis)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(shiny)
library(DT)
library(downr)

# Configuration
base_research_dir <- research_dir()
base_out <- file.path(dirname(base_research_dir), "Projects2/Antigravity/SNP_conservation")

# Load Results
results <- sysgenAnalysis::read_conserve_analysis(base_out)
trait_names <- names(results$all_results)
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Summary

```{r}
tagList(
  renderPrint({ summary(results) }),
  hr(),
  h4("Debug: Counts"),
  verbatimTextOutput("debug_counts")
)
```

## Tables

```{r}
fluidRow(
  column(4,
    selectInput("table_type", "Table Type", 
                choices = c("Global Hotspots", "Trait-Specific")),
    uiOutput("trait_select_table"),
    downr::downloadUI("download_table")
  ),
  column(8,
    DT::dataTableOutput("out_table")
  )
)
```

## Plots

```{r}
fluidRow(
  column(4,
    selectInput("plot_type", "Plot Type", 
                choices = c("Global Hotspot", "Trait-Specific")),
    uiOutput("trait_select_plot"),
    downr::downloadUI("download_plot")
  ),
  column(8,
    plotOutput("out_plot", height = "600px")
  )
)
```

:::

```{r}
#| context: server

# Dynamic selectors for traits
output$trait_select_table <- renderUI({
  if (input$table_type == "Trait-Specific") {
    selectInput("selected_trait_table", "Select Trait", 
                choices = trait_names)
  }
})

output$trait_select_plot <- renderUI({
  if (input$plot_type == "Trait-Specific") {
    selectInput("selected_trait_plot", "Select Trait", 
                choices = trait_names)
  }
})

# Reactive data for table
reactive_table <- reactive({
  if (input$table_type == "Global Hotspots") {
    results$hotspots
  } else {
    req(input$selected_trait_table)
    results$all_results[[input$selected_trait_table]]
  }
})

output$out_table <- DT::renderDataTable({
  datatable(reactive_table(), 
            options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE),
            rownames = FALSE)
})

# Reactive plot
reactive_plot <- reactive({
  if (input$plot_type == "Global Hotspot") {
    plot(results)
  } else {
    req(input$selected_trait_plot)
    plot(results, trait_name = input$selected_trait_plot)
  }
})

output$out_plot <- renderPlot({
  p <- reactive_plot()
  if (is.null(p)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  p
})

# Debug output for counts
output$debug_counts <- renderPrint({
  list(
    hotspots_count = nrow(results$hotspots),
    traits_available = names(results$all_results),
    trait_counts = sapply(results$all_results, nrow)
  )
})

# Download servers
downr::downloadServer("download_table", reactive_table)
downr::downloadServer("download_plot", reactive_plot)
```
